items.title: Show HN: Mithril, Bitstillery Edition
items.contentSnippet:
https://github.com/bitstillery/mithril is a heavily modified (AI) version of Mithril, that features Signals, a State proxy, SSR, full Typescript & Bun tooling as well as several performance tweaks.
We like Mithril a lot, but some parts felt a bit outdated. Instead of switching to another framework, we decided to fork it and modernize the parts we weren't happy with.

items.title: Show HN: Sayrud – Yet Another Collaborative Spreadsheet
items.contentSnippet:
Sayrud is an open-source, self-hosted collaborative spreadsheet with grid, kanban, gallery and form views.
It supports real-time collaboration, formulas and SSO with your existing IdP. Custom JavaScript field shortcuts can connect to models like TypeSafe's Jev to classify field values.
Runs with Docker Compose. AGPL-3.0.
Website: https://sayrud.com
Demo: https://try.sayrud.com (GitHub sign-in required)
GitHub: https://github.com/sayrud/sayrud
